description: This file contains CMake functions that convert JSON strings into CMake-compatible strings by handling escaping sequences and quotation marks.

methods.name: json_string_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a JSON-encoded string into a CMake string by removing quotes and handling escape sequences.

methods.name: json_string_ref_to_cmake
methods.description: Converts a reference to a JSON string variable into a CMake string by dereferencing and using json_string_to_cmake.
